'''2019 Worlds Day 2 Justin Carulli DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2019 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open AOBS Carulli DS 2019 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127130309/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ Internet Archive]
